gloss: to pierce through; to break through; to pass through

definitions.gloss: to pierce through; to penetrate; to go right through
definitions.explanation: To physically pass through something from one side to the other, or to break through a barrier or obstacle.

definitions.gloss: to stand out dramatically; to be strikingly (clear, bright, etc.)
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to describe something that is exceptionally vivid, clear, or outstanding, as if it has broken through ordinary limits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弾丸|だんがん}→弾丸：12502_dangan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}けた。
examples.english: The bullet pierced through the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}ける⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: After passing through the alley, I came out onto a wide street.

examples.english: Breaking through the rain clouds, the airplane emerged above a blue sky.

examples.english: A piercingly high voice echoed through the venue.

notes:
Compound verb from ⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ (to thrust, to poke) + ⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ (to come out, to pass through). The combination emphasizes forceful passage through a barrier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}ける: to pierce through a wall
- {突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}けるような⟦{青空|あおぞら}→青空：10084_aozora⟧: a strikingly clear blue sky
- {突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}けるような⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: a piercing voice

TRANSITIVITY:
Both transitive (⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧) and intransitive usage. Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ when specifying what is being pierced through.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貫|つらぬ}く→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧: to penetrate, pierce — emphasizes going all the way through
- ⟦{通|とお}り{抜|ぬ}ける→通り抜ける：14422_toorinukeru⟧: to pass through — more neutral, less forceful
